{'id':'Q75','requested_parts':['Whether Fire markers can be placed in unexplored Rooms','Whether Malfunction markers can be placed in unexplored Rooms'], 'answer':'1. {'id':'Q77','requested_parts':['What happens to Heavy Objects on Character death in standard play','What happens to the Character’s Item cards'], 'answer':'1. {'id':'Q78','requested_parts':['Whether reaching the next yellow Self-Destruct space unlocks Pods again after they were relocked'], 'answer':'No. Pods unlock automatically only when Self-Destruct first reaches a yellow space. {'id':'Q79','requested_parts':['Whether destroying the ship fulfills kill-the-Queen or destroy-the-Nest Objective requirements','Whether ship destruction alone makes the Character a winner'], 'answer':'1. q=byid['Q05']
q['answer']=(
"1. Flip the unexplored Room tile face up, reveal and resolve its Exploration token, set the Item Counter to the shown number (except the Nest and Room Covered With Slime, which have no Item count), then remove the token from the game. The effect is: Slime places a Slime marker on your Character board; Fire places a Fire marker in the Room; Malfunction places a Malfunction marker in the Room; Doors places a Door token in the Corridor by which you entered. 2. After the Exploration result, make the ordinary Noise roll only if the destination is empty and the result was neither Silence nor Danger. On a 1–4, place Noise in the connected Corridor with that number; if it already has Noise, resolve an Encounter instead. 3. Silence means no Movement Noise roll and nothing happens, unless your Character has Slime, in which case resolve Danger instead. Danger also replaces the roll: move all eligible neighboring Intruders into the Room; if none are eligible, place Noise in every connected Corridor without a marker. If a Character or Intruder is already in the destination, do not make a Movement Noise roll."
)
q['evidence']=(
'[1] After entering a Room: “(1) if the Room tile was unexplored (face down), flip it face up and reveal and resolve its Exploration token, then return that token to the box (removed from the game); (2) apply the Movement Noise rule.” Item Counter: “the Nest and Room Covered With Slime get no Item count. For other Room tiles, rotate the tile until the Exploration token\'s number faces the Item Counter symbol printed on the board next to the slot.” Exploration effects: “Slime — place a Slime (Status) marker on your Character board.” “Fire — place a Fire marker in this Room.” “Malfunction — place a Malfunction marker in this Room.” “Doors — place a Door token in the Corridor by which you entered.” [2–3] After entering a Room: “A Silence or Danger Exploration result replaces the Movement Noise roll: resolve that result and do not roll Noise again afterward. Otherwise, perform the ordinary Noise roll if the destination is empty (no Characters, no Intruders).” Noise roll: “Result 1, 2, 3, or 4: place a Noise marker in the Corridor with that number connected to the Room you entered (counting Technical Corridors if the Room has an Entrance). A Corridor may never hold more than 1 Noise marker — if instructed to place a marker where one already is, resolve an Encounter instead.” Exploration effects: “Silence — no Movement Noise roll. Nothing happens. If your Character has a Slime marker, resolve \"Danger\" instead.” “Danger — no Movement Noise roll. Move ALL eligible Intruders from neighboring Rooms into this Room (eligible means not in Combat with any Character). If there are none eligible, place a Noise marker in every Corridor connected to this Room that lacks one, counting Technical Corridors if the Room has an Entrance.” After entering a Room: “If anyone — Character or Intruder — is already there, do NOT roll for Movement Noise.”'
)

q=byid['Q06']
q['answer']=(
"1. Careful Movement costs 2 Action cards and replaces the post-movement Noise roll with placing a Noise marker in a chosen Corridor connected to the Room entered; it also replaces automatic Silence/Danger Exploration results with that chosen Noise placement. 2. It cannot be used in Combat or when all Corridors connected to the destination already contain Noise. 3. It follows normal Movement restrictions, so a Closed Door blocks passage. 4. q['evidence']=(

The FAQ clarifies that Careful Movement also replaces automatic Silence/Danger Exploration results with its chosen Noise placement; Reconnaissance cancels those automatic results too.” [4] Movement, Rooms, and Corridors: “Characters and Intruders may only occupy Rooms (Special Rooms — Hibernatorium, Cockpit, Engines — count as Rooms; Escape Pod tokens are the only exception for Characters). Corridors connect Rooms; no one may ever stop in a Corridor.”'
)

q=byid['Q12']

A Fire marker normally destroys 1 uncarried Egg during every Event Phase Fire Damage step. For the Nest Egg pool, Vulnerability to Fire increases this to 2 Eggs per step. 5. A successful Egg Melee retains the normal draw of 1 Contamination card onto the Action discard pile. A missed Egg Melee causes neither Contamination nor a Wound. The summary leaves the timing of the normal pre-roll Contamination step versus the miss exception unresolved. 6. Roll Noise after every Shoot, Melee, Grenade, or Molotov attempt to destroy an Egg, including a miss; for a remote Grenade or Molotov, roll in your own Room, not the Nest. 7. )
q['support']='partial'

'[1–4] Egg destruction table: “Shoot or Melee | Each Injury destroys 1 Egg. Resolve the normal attack, with the Egg Melee exception below.” “Grenade | Destroys 2 Eggs. For the Nest’s Egg pool, Vulnerability to Fire increases this to 2 per step (FAQ Rooms 7).” [5] “Egg Melee penalties: a successful Egg Melee retains the normal draw of 1 Contamination card onto your Action discard pile. The manuals do not specify how to reconcile the normal pre-roll Contamination step with this miss exception; no refund or alternative draw timing is specified.” [6] “Noise after an attack attempt: after every single Shoot, Melee, Grenade or Molotov attempt to destroy an Egg, perform a Noise roll, including a miss. For a remote Grenade/Molotov, roll in your own Room, not the Nest (FAQ Rooms 2).” [7] Objective type: “Destroy the Nest — no Intruder Eggs may remain in it.” Therefore the Nest is destroyed once its Egg pool has no Eggs remaining.'
)

q=byid['Q72']
q['answer']=(
'1. No. A sleeper takes no later Fire wounds in the Hibernatorium. 2. )
